gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies that the Q matrix produced by {@link TriDiagonalTransformer} is orthogonal, i.e. that Q<sup>T</sup>Q equals the identity matrix.

ADDED i3: A 3x3 symmetric test matrix.
ADDED i4: Largest acceptable deviation of Q<sup>T</sup>Q from the identity matrix.
ADDED i5: Asserts that the Q matrix of the tri-diagonal transformation of the given matrix is orthogonal.
